lines: You reach the top of the dam.
The rain is a torrential downpour.
Jonah stands by the detonator console. He looks back at you.

j2.text: But the town is built on poison. The mines have to be flooded to hide the toxins. Or we all go to prison.

w1.text: Don't listen to him. You can shut down his console by sending a feedback loop to his earpiece.

g1.text: Open the Calls app and trigger a feedback loop.

config.brief: Tune the frequency to 102.4 to deafen Jonah and make him drop the detonator.

lines: Jonah screams, clutching his ear, and drops the detonator.
You lunge forward and grab it.
But the timer is still ticking. 10 seconds.

w2.text: Enter the abort code. It's the passcode we used.
